Hadith.3123 - Al-Haytham ibn Urwah al-Tamimi said to Abu Abdullah (as):
"I carried my wife, who was ill, and performed Tawaf with her around the Kaaba for the obligatory Tawaf, as well as between Safa and Marwah, and I counted it as fulfilling the obligation for myself. Does it suffice for me?"
Imam (as) replied: "Yes."
